item.description:
Agents on every Mac add up
FIXED Agents running on two Macs signed in to the same account now add up instead of one Mac's count replacing the other's. Install Firstlight on the Mac where your agents run and both show on your profile.
IMPROVED Settings no longer offers a public page before you have a username; it takes you to pick one first.

Declining a friend request stays between you
CHANGED Declining a friend request no longer tells the person who sent it: on their side it still reads as sent, and on their profile you can still accept it. Adding back someone whose request you declined makes you friends at once.
IMPROVED On a profile with nothing under the name, hovering the app or agents badge slides the profile down instead of making it jump.

Friends now means friends, on the Leaderboard too
CHANGED Choosing Friends, Totals or Nobody in Settings, under Privacy, keeps you off the Leaderboard: your apps, agents and time stay with your friends and your groups. Every account that never answered the privacy question now stands at Anyone, which is the answer the Leaderboard reads.
ADDED firstlight.sh/changelog opens every release, this one included.
IMPROVED The Websites page, in Settings under Integrations, draws its mark the way the rest of Settings draws its own.
